title.narrative: Tamil Nadu Urban Flagship Investment Program

description.narrative: The program will develop priority water supply, sewerage, and drainage infrastructure in at least 10 cities located within strategic industrial corridors of Tamil Nadu. It will support innovative pilots, including India's first solar-powered sewage treatment plant (STP) to offset greenhouse gas emissions and enhance operational efficiency; strengthen urban governance; and build capacity of state and local institutions to enhance urban service delivery, environmental sustainability, and climate resilience.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Livability and climate resilience in at least 10 cities in priority industrial corridors enhanced.

e. At least 3,400 tons of carbon dioxide equivalent per year in greenhouse gas emissions avoided (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Works for solar power plant in Coimbatore completed in 2022. Actual achievements will be assessed after completion of all three tranches under the program. Data Source: MAWS annual policy notes, program quarterly progress reports Actual value:

d. NRW in coverage areas of four cities reduced to 20% (2017 baseline: on average 30%) Progress/Status: Implementation of Tranches 1, 2, and 3 are under progress. Actual achievements will be assessed after completion of all three tranches under the program. Data Source: MAWS annual policy notes, program quarterly progress reports Actual value:

f. At least 52,000 cubic meters/day of treated wastewater reused for industrial purposes in three cities (2017 baseline: 32,000 cubic meters/day of treated wastewater reused in Chennai). Progress/Status: Implementation of Tranches 1, 2 and 3 are under progress and all relevant contract packages related to sewage (for Tranche 1 and 2) have been awarded. Actual achievements will be assessed after completion of all three tranches under the program. Data Source: MAWS annual policy notes, program quarterly progress reports Actual value:

c. Frequency and duration of water supply improved to at least 6 hours/day provided to 100% of households in the coverage areas in four cities (2017 baseline: water provided on average 1-2 hours/day, once in 1-2 days, 48% piped water coverage). Progress/Status: Implementation of Tranches 1, 2 and 3 are under progress. Actual achievements will be assessed after completion of all three tranches under the program. Data Source: MAWS annual policy notes, program quarterly progress reports Actual value:

g. Collection efficiency of sewerage user fees in eight cities with piped sewerage systems increased by at least 15% (2017 baseline: 49% collection efficiency) Progress/Status: Implementation of Tranches 1, 2 and 3 are under progress and all relevant contract packages related to sewage (for Tranche 1 and 2) have been awarded. Actual achievements will be assessed after completion of all three tranches under the program. Data Source: MAWS annual policy notes, program quarterly progress reports Actual value:

By 2027: a. Collection and treatment of sewage in program coverage areas of eight cities increased to 100% of households (2017 baseline: sewage collected from 7.6% of households in coverage areas) Progress/Status: Implementation of Tranches 1, 2, and 3 are under progress and all relevant contract packages related to sewage (for Tranche 1 and 2) have been awarded. Tranche 3 (last tranche of $125 million under ADB financing) was approved in November 2022, and declared effective on 14 February 2023. Actual achievements will be assessed after completion of all three tranches under the program. Data Source: MAWS annual policy notes, program quarterly progress reports Actual value:

b. Flood risk reduced in 100% of flood-prone areas covered by new drainage systems adapted to climate change in three cities (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Stormwater drainage subproject is included in Tranche 3 (which was approved in November 2022 and declared effective on 14 February 2023) and implementation is under progress. Actual achievements will be assessed after completion of all three tranches under the program. Data Source: MAWS annual policy notes, program quarterly progress reports Base year: 2017 Baseline value: Y
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Climate-resilient sewage collection and treatment, and drainage systems developed in at least eight cities Indicator: 173 sewage pump stations with combined capacity of 6,390 kilowatts added (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: All sewage pump station contracts under tranches 1 and 2 have been awarded with combined number of 124 and 69 pump stations respectively. Actual achievements will be measured when works are completed. Data Source: Periodic ULB records (periodic), and program quarterly progress reports Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Climate-resilient sewage collection and treatment, and drainage systems developed in at least eight cities Indicator: 2,810 km of new sewage collection pipelines commissioned and connected to 426,600 households including 100% poor and poor women headed households in the coverage area (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: All sewage contracts under Tranche 1 and Tranche 2 have been awarded and are under construction with total of about 1,864 km and 1,328 km of pipelines and connections for approx except for Tirunelveli Sewerage - Phase-III which was ternimated and balace work has been bid out split into three packages. 290,000 and 150,000 households expected under respective tranches.
Works are in progress in collection system under 2 packages: (i) TNUIFP/CBE/04: with physical progress of 2.5%, and completed the following: 10.89 km sewer lines, 61 machine holes, and 57 HSCs) (ii) TNUIFP/CBE/05: with physical progress of 4%, and completed the following: 8.5 km sewer lines, 280 machine holes, and 215 HSCs)
Actual achievements will be measured when works are completed. Data Source: Periodic ULB records (periodic), and program quarterly progress reports Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Climate-resilient sewage collection and treatment, and drainage systems developed in at least eight cities Indicator: 20 all-female community-based organizations trained as water and sanitation committees and 100% participants reporting improved knowledge of benefits of sewage collection systems and household connections (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Governance Improvement and Awareness Consultant (GIAC) mobilized in Q4 2019 and activities are ongoing. Actual achievements will be measured when training is completed. Data Source: Post-training surveys Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Climate-resilient sewage collection and treatment, and drainage systems developed in at least eight cities Indicator: 250 km of new tertiary and 50 km of primary and secondary stormwater drains constructed and improved with climate-resilient designs (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Preliminary works for Construction of Stormwater drain packages are in progress. Actual achievements will be measured when works are completed. Data Source: Periodic ULB records (periodic), and program quarterly progress reports Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Climate-resilient sewage collection and treatment, and drainage systems developed in at least eight cities Indicator: By 2026: Three STPs with combined capacity of 155 MLD rehabilitated and seven new STPs with combined capacity of 187 MLD added (2017 Baseline: 0 rehabilitated and new) Progress/Status: All STP contracts under Tranche 1 have been awarded and construction is underway for combined capacity of approx. 165 MLD (new STPs) and approx. 37 MLD (rehabilitation of STPs) except for Tirunelveli Sewerage - Phase-III which was ternimated and balace work has been bid out split into three packages. The cities are Coimbatore, Rajapalayam, Tirunelveli, Trichy and Vellore. Under Tranche 2, rehabilitation of approx. 15 MLD STP and construction of 2 STPs with total capacity of approx. 72 MLD are ongoing in Ambur and Tirrupur. Actual achievements will be measured when works are completed.
For Tranche 3, STP package's procurement is still in progress. Data Source: Periodic ULB records (periodic), and program quarterly progress reports Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Trainings on related themes such as STP O&M, upgradation of old non-SBR STPs are expected to be completed by Q1 2024. Data Source: MAWS Annual Policy Note and program quarterly progress reports. Data Source: MAWS Annual Policy Note and program quarterly progress reports. Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: Y Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: Y Target year: 2020 Target value: N

Output: Institutional capacity, public awareness, and urban governance strengthened Indicator: By 2026, 1,000 school students, teachers and administrators (at least 50% women); and 30 women SHGs reported improved awareness on water conservation and hygiene (2017 Baseline: 0) Progress/Status: On track to achieve target. Actual achievements will be measured when related activities are completed. Output: Water supply systems in at least five cities improved with smart features Indicator: 30 new pump stations with combined capacity of 1,530 kilowatts installed, and 120 km new transmission mains constructed (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: All water supply contracts under Tranche 1 have been awarded and are under implementation. 5 pump stations with combined capacity of approx. 231 kilowatts will be installed and 11km of new transmission mains will be constructed. For Tranche 2, 9 water supply contracts are under implementation while 1 is in process of procurement. Expected outputs are: installation of 3 pump stations with combined capacity of approx. 7,225kW, and construction of 196km of new transmission mains.
For Tranche 3, preliminary works are ongoing for Construction of Stormwater drain packages.
Actual achievements will be measured when works are completed. Data Source: ULB Records and program quarterly progress reports Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Water supply systems in at least five cities improved with smart features Indicator: 40 new reservoirs with combined capacity of 70 million liters constructed (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: All water supply contracts have been awarded under Tranche 1 and are under implementation to construct 9 reservoirs with combined capacity of 11 million liters. For Tranche 2, 9 water supply contracts are under implementation while 1 is in process of procurement. Construction of 66 reservoirs with combined capacity of 92 million litters is expected under the tranche. Actual achievements will be measured when works are completed. Data Source: ULB Records and program quarterly progress reports Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Water supply systems in at least five cities improved with smart features Indicator: At least 80% technical staff from each implementing agency in four cities reported improved knowledge and/or skills in NRW reduction as a result of training, with 75% participation of women technical staff (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: On track to achieve target. Actual achievements will be measured when training is completed. Data Source: ULB Records and program quarterly progress reports Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Water supply systems in at least five cities improved with smart features Indicator: By 2026: 1,520 km new water distribution pipelines commissioned within 110 new district metered areas and metered connections provided to 171,000 households (100% households including poor and poor women households in coverage area) (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: All water supply contracts under Tranche 1 have been awarded and are under implementation with total of approx. 275 km of new pipelines, 20 district metered areas and metered connections to approx. 30,800 households expected.
